params.prompt: A memory-like image in faded, washed-out colours like an old pencil and watercolour drawing: a quiet harbour street at dusk; an elderly woman in a long red coat walks slowly away from the viewer along the pavement, past a small shop window, holding a simple walking stick; she is seen only from behind, her short white hair visible, her face not visible at all; only the red coat keeps its colour, everything else is soft sepia and pale blue. Calm and a little mysterious, not sad, not scary. Vertical composition. Warm animated-series illustration, graphic-novel style, clean ink lines, soft cel shading, coastal palette of sea blue, sand, lighthouse yellow and evening orange, mature tone suitable for teens and adults, not childish, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
